title: retry.yml log group titles use the full PR URL, not the PR number
answers: retry workflow log groups show only PR number
how to find the PR for a retry log group
why is the retry group title a URL
PR group title in retry log
body:
Convention: The per-PR log group in the retry workflow is titled with the full pull request URL, built from the repository and PR number, rather than the bare "PR #<number>" label.
Where enforced: .github/workflows/retry.yml, the `while IFS=$'\t' read -r number sha` loop that emits `echo "::group::https://github.com/$GH_REPO/pull/$number"` before calling retry.sh.
Why it matters: The stated goal is that reruns are easy to locate and collect from the logs; a bare number does not link anywhere, while the URL is stable and clickable.
Constraints: Keep the URL built from $GH_REPO so that it matches the repository used for the rerun calls. Changing the title back to a number reverses the discoverability fix.
applies: Applies to log group titles in .github/workflows/retry.yml; does not cover the rerun notices printed by retry.sh.
